This book is intended to serve as a reference tool for cli-
nicians and students of athletic training.

text: It provides quick reference to over 2100 terms related to the field of athletic training.

training.

bone ends are most congruent and joint surface contact
is maximal and compressed.

text: MEMBERSHIP STANDARDS In accepting membership in NATA, an applicant agrees that:

MEMBERSHIP STANDARDS
In accepting membership in NATA, an applicant agrees
that:

text: A.

text: He or she will comply with the Charter, by-laws, poli- cies, rules, and standards of NATA and the laws and regulations governing NATA.

He or she will comply with the Charter, by-laws, poli-
cies, rules, and standards of NATA and the laws and
regulations governing NATA.

The applicant also agrees
to bear the burden for demonstrating and maintaining
compliance with these provisions at all times.

text: The cards and logos of NATA, the name "National Athletic Trainers' Association, Inc.," the term "NATA," the terms "ATC" and "CAT," and abbreviations relating thereto are all exclusive property of the NATA and may not be used in any way without the express written consent of NATA.

The cards and logos of NATA, the name "National
Athletic Trainers' Association, Inc.," the term "NATA,"
the terms "ATC" and "CAT," and abbreviations relating
thereto are all exclusive property of the NATA and may
not be used in any way without the express written
consent of NATA.

text: The individual shall immediately relinquish, refrain from using and correct at the individual's expense any outdated or other inaccurate use of any NATA card, logo, mark, and emblem and of the NATA name and related abbreviations, in case of suspension, limitation, or cancellation by, or resignation from NATA, or as oth- erwise requested by NATA.

logo, mark, and emblem and of the NATA name and
related abbreviations, in case of suspension, limitation,
or cancellation by, or resignation from NATA, or as oth-

text: If the individual refuses to relinquish immediately, refrain from using and correct at his or her expense any misuse or misleading use of any of the above items when requested, the individual agrees that NATA shall be entitled to obtain injunctive relief, damages, costs and attorney's fees incurred in obtaining any such or other relief.

text: ELIGIBILITY FOR MEMBERSHIP A.
text_raw:
ELIGIBILITY FOR MEMBERSHIP
A.

text: No individual is eligible for membership unless he or she agrees to comply, and, when a member, is in com- pliance with all NATA Charter provisions, By-laws, policies, rules, standards, and other governing laws and regulations.
text_raw:
No individual is eligible for membership unless he or
she agrees to comply, and, when a member, is in com-
pliance with all NATA Charter provisions, By-laws,
policies, rules, standards, and other governing laws
and regulations.

text: NATA may take appropriate action with respect to members' violations of these Charter provisions, By-laws, policies, rules, standards and other governing laws and regulations.
text_raw:
NATA may take appropriate action
with respect to members' violations of these Charter
provisions, By-laws, policies, rules, standards and other
governing laws and regulations.

text: B.
text_raw: B.

text: The individual must truthfully complete and sign an application in the form provided by NATA and shall provide additional information as requested.
text_raw:
The individual must truthfully complete and sign an
application in the form provided by NATA and shall
provide additional information as requested.

text: The indi- vidual must notify NATA of any change in address, telephone number, and any other facts bearing on eligi- bility or membership within thirty (30) days of such occurrence.
text_raw:
The indi-
vidual must notify NATA of any change in address,
telephone number, and any other facts bearing on eligi-
bility or membership within thirty (30) days of such
occurrence.

text: C.
text_raw: C.

text: An individual convicted of a felony directly related to public health, athletic care, or education shall be ineli- gible to apply for membership for a period of one year from the exhaustion of appeals, completion of sentence, or completion of parole, whichever is later.
text_raw:
An individual convicted of a felony directly related to
public health, athletic care, or education shall be ineli-
gible to apply for membership for a period of one year
from the exhaustion of appeals, completion of sentence,
or completion of parole, whichever is later.

text: Convictions of this nature include but are not limited to felonies involving: rape; sexual abuse of an athlete or child; actual or threatened use of a weapon or violence; the prohibited sale or distribution of a controlled sub- stance, or its possession with the intent to distribute; or use of position of athletic trainer improperly (i) to influ- ence or attempt to influence the outcome or score of an athletic event or (ii) in connection with any gambling activity.

text: Grounds for Sanctions When a person becomes a member of NATA, he or she assumes certain obligations and responsibilities.
text_raw:
Grounds for Sanctions
When a person becomes a member of NATA, he or she
assumes certain obligations and responsibilities.

text: A mem- ber is responsible for dues as provided and specified by the By-laws or other governing provisions.
text_raw:
A mem-
ber is responsible for dues as provided and specified by
the By-laws or other governing provisions.

text: A member may be subject to one or more of the sanctions set forth in Section III G, below, if his or her conduct falls within one of the following categories:

A member may
be subject to one or more of the sanctions set forth in
Section III G, below, if his or her conduct falls within one
of the following categories:

text: Misstatement of a material fact or failure to state a material fact in an application for membership, or in any other manner obtaining or attempting to obtain NATA membership by fraud or deception;

text: Knowingly assisting another to obtain or attempt to obtain NATA membership by false statement, fraud or deception;
Misrepresentation of NATA membership status;

text: Misrepresentation of NATA certification status, or other professional qualification or credentials;
text_raw:
Misrepresentation of NATA certification status, or other
professional qualification or credentials;

text: Panels 1.
text_raw:
Panels
1.

text: With general oversight from the NATA Board of Directors, the NATA Ethics Committee, by majority vote, shall select persons who are NATA members to form (i) an Investigative Panel of NATA members, (ii) a Fact-Finding Panel of NATA members, and (iii) an Appellate Panel of NATA members, to address alleged violations of the standards set forth in Sections III A(1)- (6), above.
text_raw:
With general oversight from the NATA Board of
Directors, the NATA Ethics Committee, by majority
vote, shall select persons who are NATA members to
form (i) an Investigative Panel of NATA members, (ii) a
Fact-Finding Panel of NATA members, and (iii) an
Appellate Panel of NATA members, to address alleged
violations of the standards set forth in Sections III A(1)-
(6), above.

text: The majority of each of these panels shall consist of Ethics Committee members, and a majority of each of the Presiding Panels selected to handle individ- ual cases shall, if possible, be Ethics Committee mem- bers.
text_raw:
The majority of each of these panels shall
consist of Ethics Committee members, and a majority of
each of the Presiding Panels selected to handle individ-
ual cases shall, if possible, be Ethics Committee mem-
bers.

text: The Ethics Committee shall attempt to staff Presiding Panels with members from (a) a variety of practice settings, (b) geographically diverse locations, and (c) diverse backgrounds and levels of experience.
text_raw:
The Ethics Committee shall attempt to staff
Presiding Panels with members from (a) a variety of
practice settings, (b) geographically diverse locations,
and (c) diverse backgrounds and levels of experience.

text: The terms of the members of each of the three Panels shall run for two years and may be renewed.
text_raw:
The terms of the members of each of the three Panels
shall run for two years and may be renewed.

text: A majority of the members of each Panel shall annually elect the Chair of that Panel.
text_raw:
A majority of the members of each Panel shall annually
elect the Chair of that Panel.

text: In every individual case, three members of the Investigative Panel shall carry out the requisite inves- tigative function; three members of the Fact-Finding Panel shall carry out the requisite hearing function; and three members of the Appellate Panel (one Ethics Committee member, one at-large member, and one director from the Board) shall carry out the requisite appellate function.

Committee member, one at-large member, and one
director from the Board) shall carry out the requisite
appellate function.
